input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The grant is good on two of the three material terms: our affiliates are expressly covered without any notice condition (better than the fallback), and the licence is perpetual so long as fees are paid (Section 17(a)) with no right for Garman to revoke at will — termination is limited to insolvency events and uncured material breach on 30 days' notice (Section 17(c)(7)), and on Garman's default the licence converts to a fully paid perpetual licence (p0128, p0115). It fails the fallback on transferability: the licence is "non-transferable", Section 3(c) bars assignment or sublicence to any Person absent Garman's written consent, and Section 20(d) requires the other party's consent for any assignment, with no successor/M&A carve-out. Contractors acting on our behalf are also unaddressed, so their use depends on Garman's discretionary consent. Redline adds contractors to the licensed user group and a consent-free assignment to a successor in a merger or sale of the business, reaching the preferred position with minimal change.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf, in each case operating at Authorized Locations

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, except that, notwithstanding Sections 2 and 3(c), either party may assign this Agreement and the licence granted hereunder, without consent, to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added contractors acting on our behalf to the licensed user group (our affiliates are already covered) and a consent-free assignment right to a successor in a merger or sale of the business, consistent with our playbook position that the licence must reach our affiliates and contractors and follow us through an M&A transaction. Happy to make the successor carve-out mutual as drafted and to keep contractors bound by the Section 3 use restrictions.
proposal.summary: Extend licence to Sparkling's contractors and permit assignment of the licence to a successor in an M&A transaction.
